record_title: Sharp large-noise asymptotics for variance-gamma medians
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Pointwise asymptotics for fixed shape r and fixed nonzero asymmetry theta only; no uniform transition theory as r approaches 1 or 3, no general higher-order expansion, and no extension to non-VG generalized hyperbolic medians. Older generalized-Laplace literature remains a residual originality risk.
